description: Patch performs whole-node replacement for function/method targets only. The typical workflow is: first use node-source to read the exact current function/method source, then submit a complete replacement source through patch, optionally with node_hash/file_hash/range stale checks. This tool does not support enum, enum variant/member, struct field, type alias, or statement-level patching.

file.description: Target file that contains the function or method node to replace. Required only in single mode; omit it when patches[] is non-empty.

structural_path.description: Slash-separated structural path suffix for a function/method target only. It is not a regex or glob. Examples include main, UserService/get_user, impl MyType/new, and impl MyTrait for MyType/run. Non-function symbols are rejected.

replacement.description: Replacement source text for the whole target function/method node. It must start from the declaration line and include the complete function or method source, not a fragment.

precondition.description: Optional stale-check object for single mode. Omit top-level precondition when patches[] is non-empty; use per-item precondition instead.

node_hash.description: Expected hash of the currently matched node source.

file_hash.description: Expected hash of the current whole file source.

range.description: Expected current node line range. Accepts either a string such as L10-L42 or 10-42, or an object with start_line and end_line.

anyOf.description: Compact line range string such as L10-L42 or 10-42.

patches.description: Optional batch input. Each item must include file, structural_path, and replacement for a whole function/method node. Do not combine a non-empty patches[] with top-level file, structural_path, replacement, or precondition.

file.description: Target file that contains the function or method node to replace.

structural_path.description: Slash-separated structural path suffix for the target function/method node.

replacement.description: Complete replacement source for the whole function/method node.

precondition.description: Optional stale-check object for the current batch item.

node_hash.description: Expected hash of the currently matched node source.

file_hash.description: Expected hash of the current whole file source.

range.description: Expected current node line range. Accepts either a string such as L10-L42 or 10-42, or an object with start_line and end_line.

anyOf.description: Compact line range string such as L10-L42 or 10-42.

atomic.description: Whether the batch should be all-or-nothing. Defaults to true. Set false only when partial application is explicitly desired.

max_patches.description: Maximum patch requests to process in one call. Defaults to 20.
